item.title: Drift Off Tonight 🌙 1 Min 432Hz Sleep Music
item.description:
Settle in and breathe. "Celestial Drift" blends warm ambient pads tuned to 432Hz, soft piano, a slow drift through starlight, and a subtle theta-wave binaural undertone to guide you into deep calm.
Perfect for: 🧘 Meditation & breathwork 😴 Stress relief and deep relaxation 📖 Quiet focus, reading, or journaling 🌙 Winding down before sleep
What you're hearing: • Ambient pads in 432Hz tuning — warm, slowly evolving harmonies • Soft piano — sparse, gentle melodies • A slow drift through starlight • Theta binaural undertone — headphones recommended for the full effect
Find a comfortable position, breathe slowly, and let the sound carry you.
New meditation music every day — subscribe so you never miss a session. 🙏
🌿 Stay connected: Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/mymeditationalmedicine/ All sessions → https://www.youtube.com/@Meditationalmedicine
📖 My new book, "Meditational Medicine: Stillness for Beginners," is out now on Amazon -- Kindle (free with Kindle Unlimited) and paperback. If you've ever tried meditation and given up, this is the guide I wish I'd had: 9 simple techniques, a day-by-day 30-day plan, and guided scripts for sleep, anxiety, and calm. Search the title on Amazon to grab your copy.
